name: West Holdings Corporation
summary: West Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the renewable energy business in Japan and internationally. It operates through Renewable Energy Business, Power Storage Business, Energy Saving Business, Electric Power Business, and Maintenance Business segments. The company is involved in the engineering, construction, and procurement of industrial solar power plants, as well as development and sale of non-FIT solar power plants; develops and sells grid-use storage station; and provides total energy saving services using LED lighting and air conditioning equipment.
